title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - Apparitions Stalk The Night (Stage-Clear-Mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Apparitions Stalk The Night (from Touhou 6 Koumakyou ~ Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil) as a "stage-clear-mix".

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. A Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. G# Minor (MIDI Pitch)

There are also customizable options for enabling & disabling the goal tape sound that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Goal SFX [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Goal SFX
